versions.subject: feat: multiple updates and new rules (#4242)
versions.detection:
selection_redirect:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\wscript.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '>>%APPDATA%\Microsoft\'
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - '.xml'
        - '.txt'
selection_recon_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Taken from a6f9043627f8be2452153b5dbf6278e9b91763c3b5c2aea537a859e0c8c6b504
        # If you find samples using other commands please add them
        - 'dir'
        - 'ipconfig /all'
        - 'systeminfo'
        - 'tasklist'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\wscript.exe" Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine="*>>%APPDATA%\\Microsoft\\*" CommandLine IN ("*.xml", "*.txt") CommandLine IN ("*dir*", "*ipconfig /all*", "*systeminfo*", "*tasklist*")

versions.subject: Merge PR #5708 from @nasbench - Multiple updates and issue fixes
versions.detection:
selection_redirect:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\wscript.exe'
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '>>%APPDATA%\Microsoft\'
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - '.xml'
        - '.txt'
selection_recon_cmd:
    - CommandLine|re: 'ipconfig\s+/all'
    - CommandLine|contains:
          # Taken from a6f9043627f8be2452153b5dbf6278e9b91763c3b5c2aea537a859e0c8c6b504
          # If you find samples using other commands please add them
          - 'dir'
          - 'systeminfo'
          - 'tasklist'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: | rex field=CommandLine "(?<CommandLineMatch>ipconfig\\s+/all)" | eval CommandLineCondition=if(isnotnull(CommandLineMatch), "true", "false") | search ParentImage="*\\wscript.exe" Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine="*>>%APPDATA%\\Microsoft\\*" CommandLine IN ("*.xml", "*.txt") CommandLineCondition="true" OR CommandLine IN ("*dir*", "*systeminfo*", "*tasklist*")
